# Power-tools fixtures

Deterministic inputs for slice 8's power-tool tests. `generate.mjs` writes exactly `N` ASCII lines (LF, one record per line) from a fixed seed: line `NNNNNN` is `line-NNNNNN | ` followed by 1–10 words from a fixed word list, and every tenth line is an exact copy of the line five above it, so a dedupe always removes exactly `floor(N / 10)` lines. Regenerate the committed sample with `node test/fixtures/powertools/generate.mjs 200 test/fixtures/powertools/sort-dedupe.txt` and review the diff; the 100,000-line file is generated at test time and never committed, mirroring `test/fixtures/big`.

## `sort-dedupe.txt`

Generated by `node test/fixtures/powertools/generate.mjs 200`. Sorted results below are byte order (`LC_ALL=C sort`).

| Expected outcome | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Line count | 200 |
| Unique lines | 180 |
| Duplicates removed | 20 |

Sorted first three lines (`sort sort-dedupe.txt | head -3`):

```text
line-000001 | client result update client
line-000002 | archive memory layout output
line-000003 | filter token graph client engine event
```

Sorted last three lines (`sort sort-dedupe.txt | tail -3`):

```text
line-000197 | engine content process
line-000198 | buffer chunk
line-000199 | toolbar column editor preview inline
```

`sort -u sort-dedupe.txt` must yield 180 lines.

## `column.txt`

Twelve fixed-width ASCII lines (LF), each exactly 52 bytes including trailing space padding: `ID` at columns 1–4 (right-aligned), `NAME` at 6–23, `ROLE` at 25–38, and `CITY` at 40–52. The first row is a header; the rest are fixed-width records for column-editor selection and edits.
